```{r cars}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# 1. Load the dataset

df <- readRDS("data_ml_causal_0607.rds")

# 2. Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(12345)

# 3. Calculate patient volume per center and shuffle randomly
centers_volumetry <- df %>%
  group_by(site_abbreviation) %>%
  summarise(n_patients = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  sample_frac(1L) %>% 
  mutate(cumulative_patients = cumsum(n_patients))

# 4. Identify centers for the external validation cohort
# Select centers until the cumulative sum strictly exceeds 1000 patients
threshold_index <- which(centers_volumetry$cumulative_patients > 1000)[1]
validation_sites <- centers_volumetry$site_abbreviation[1:threshold_index]

# 5. Create the two distinct cohorts (geographical split)
validation_set <- df %>%
  filter(site_abbreviation %in% validation_sites)

training_set <- df %>%
  filter(!(site_abbreviation %in% validation_sites))

# 6. Verification of the spatial split
cat("\n--- SPATIAL SPLIT REPORT ---\n")
cat("Number of centers in the training set:", length(unique(training_set$site_abbreviation)), "\n")
cat("Number of patients in the training set:", nrow(training_set), "\n")
cat("Number of centers in the validation set:", length(unique(validation_set$site_abbreviation)), "\n")
cat("Number of patients in the validation set:", nrow(validation_set), "\n")

# 7. Quality control: check for data leakage across sets
leakage_check <- intersect(unique(training_set$site_abbreviation), unique(validation_set$site_abbreviation))

if(length(leakage_check) == 0) {
  cat("Spatial independence status: VALID (No overlapping centers)\n")
} else {
  cat("WARNING: Data leakage detected between the sets.\n")
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS: SODD BUNDLE EXPOSURE (INCLUDING CENTER-LEVEL DETAILS)
# =============================================================================

# Calculation of exposure metrics by center
sodd_center_metrics <- df %>%
  group_by(site_abbreviation) %>%
  summarise(
    total_patients_in_center = n(),
    sodd_exposed_patients = sum(SODD == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    center_uses_sodd = ifelse(sodd_exposed_patients > 0, 1, 0),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# 1. Total volume of exposed patients
total_sodd_patients <- sum(sodd_center_metrics$sodd_exposed_patients)
total_cohort_patients <- nrow(df)

# 2. Protocol penetration at the center level
total_centers <- nrow(sodd_center_metrics)
implementing_centers <- sum(sodd_center_metrics$center_uses_sodd)

# 3. Global proportion of exposure within active centers
active_centers_data <- sodd_center_metrics %>%
  filter(center_uses_sodd == 1)

proportion_in_active_centers <- sum(active_centers_data$sodd_exposed_patients) / 
                                sum(active_centers_data$total_patients_in_center)

# 4. Breakdown of proportions with and without SODD for each active center
active_centers_details <- active_centers_data %>%
  mutate(
    patients_without_sodd = total_patients_in_center - sodd_exposed_patients,
    proportion_with_sodd_pct = round((sodd_exposed_patients / total_patients_in_center) * 100, 1),
    proportion_without_sodd_pct = round((patients_without_sodd / total_patients_in_center) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Center = site_abbreviation,
    `Total Patients` = total_patients_in_center,
    `Patients with SODD` = sodd_exposed_patients,
    `% with SODD` = proportion_with_sodd_pct,
    `Patients without SODD` = patients_without_sodd,
    `% without SODD` = proportion_without_sodd_pct
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(`Total Patients`))

# Console output report
cat("\n--- EPIDEMIOLOGICAL REPORT: SODD BUNDLE ---\n")
cat(sprintf("Total patients who received SODD: %d (i.e., %.1f%% of the global cohort)\n", 
            total_sodd_patients, 
            (total_sodd_patients / total_cohort_patients) * 100))

cat(sprintf("Centers applying SODD: %d out of %d total centers (%.1f%% of sites)\n", 
            implementing_centers, 
            total_centers, 
            (implementing_centers / total_centers) * 100))

cat(sprintf("Exposure rate within centers implementing the protocol: %.1f%%\n", 
            proportion_in_active_centers * 100))

cat("\n--- PRACTICE DETAILS BY ACTIVE CENTER ---\n")
print(as.data.frame(active_centers_details), row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# =============================================================================
# CLEAN-VAP — SODD ANALYSIS (Supplementary Material)
# =============================================================================

library(lme4);      library(lmerTest)
library(tableone);  library(dplyr);    library(ggplot2)
library(AIPW);      library(tmle);     library(SuperLearner)
library(grf);       library(WeightIt); library(caret)

dir.create("CLEAN_VAP_outputs/SODD", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  SODD ANALYSIS — SUPPLEMENTARY MATERIAL\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# 0. PREPARATION — Identify SODD centers
# =============================================================================

# df_full = complete cohort (train + valid combined)
df_full <- df 

# SODD rate per center
sodd_by_centre <- df_full %>%
  mutate(SODD_bin = as.numeric(as.character(SODD))) %>%
  group_by(site_abbreviation) %>%
  summarise(
    N_total      = n(),
    N_sodd       = sum(SODD_bin, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_sodd     = mean(SODD_bin, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Centre_SODD = ifelse(Pct_sodd > 0, "SODD Centre", "Non-SODD Centre")
  )

cat("─── CENTERS IMPLEMENTING SODD ───────────────────────────────\n")
print(sodd_by_centre %>% arrange(desc(Pct_sodd)), n = Inf)

# Join center information to the full dataset
df_full <- df_full %>%
  left_join(sodd_by_centre %>%
              select(site_abbreviation, Centre_SODD, Pct_sodd),
            by = "site_abbreviation")

# =============================================================================
# PART 1 — DESCRIPTION OF SODD vs NON-SODD CENTERS (Ecological Table 1)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  PART 1 — DESCRIPTION OF SODD vs NON-SODD CENTERS\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# ── 1A. Table 1 at the PATIENT level ────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("─── TABLE 1 PATIENT LEVEL ────────────────────────────────────\n")

table1_vars <- c(
  # Demographics
  "AGE", "SEX",
  # Comorbidities
  "Myocardial_infarction", "congestive_heart_failure",
  "peripherical_vascular_disease", "COPD",
  "connective_tissue_disease", "peptic_ulcer_disease",
  "liver_disease", "diabetes_mellitus", "CKD",
  "solid_tumor", "AIDS", "CCI_score",
  "CVA_TIA_hemiplegia", "malignant_hemopathies",
  # Severity
  "SOFA", "APACHE_II", "ICU_admission",
  "Duration_days_before_ICU",
  # IS Treatments
  "Prescription_of_ATB", "Prescription_of_IS",
  "LT_corticosteroids",
  # Outcomes
  "VAPFD_28", "VFD_28", "mortality_28d", "VAP_status"
)

# Keep only existing variables
table1_vars <- table1_vars[table1_vars %in% names(df_full)]

tbl1_patient <- CreateTableOne(
  vars       = table1_vars,
  strata     = "Centre_SODD",
  data       = df_full,
  test       = TRUE,
  addOverall = TRUE
)

print(tbl1_patient, smd = TRUE, quote = FALSE, noSpaces = TRUE)

tbl1_mat <- print(tbl1_patient, smd = TRUE, printToggle = FALSE)
write.csv(tbl1_mat,
          "CLEAN_VAP_outputs/SODD/table1_patient_SODD_vs_nonSODD.csv")

# ── 1B. Table 1 at the CENTER level (ecological unit) ──────────────────────────
cat("\n─── TABLE 1 CENTER LEVEL (ecological) ───────────────────────\n")

centre_level <- df_full %>%
  group_by(site_abbreviation, Centre_SODD) %>%
  summarise(
    N_patients       = n(),
    SODD_prevalence  = mean(as.numeric(as.character(SODD)), na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_AGE         = mean(AGE, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pct_SEX_M        = mean(SEX == 1 | SEX == "M" | SEX == "Male",
                             na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    Mean_SOFA        = mean(SOFA, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_APACHE      = mean(APACHE_II, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_VAPFD28     = mean(VAPFD_28, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_VFD28       = mean(VFD_28, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mortality_pct    = mean(
      as.numeric(as.character(mortality_28d)), na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    VAP_pct = mean(as.numeric(as.character(VAP_status)), na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Summary by center group:\n")
centre_summary <- centre_level %>%
  group_by(Centre_SODD) %>%
  summarise(
    N_centres        = n(),
    N_patients_total = sum(N_patients),
    Median_SOFA      = median(Mean_SOFA, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_APACHE    = median(Mean_APACHE, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_VAPFD28     = round(mean(Mean_VAPFD28, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Mean_VFD28       = round(mean(Mean_VFD28, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Mortality_pct    = round(mean(Mortality_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(centre_summary)
write.csv(centre_level,
          "CLEAN_VAP_outputs/SODD/table1_centre_level_SODD.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# ── 1C. Plot: crude outcomes by center group ──────────────────────
outcomes_plot_df <- df_full %>%
  group_by(Centre_SODD) %>%
  summarise(
    VAPFD28_mean = mean(VAPFD_28, na.rm = TRUE),
    VAPFD28_se   = sd(VAPFD_28, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    VFD28_mean   = mean(VFD_28, na.rm = TRUE),
    VFD28_se     = sd(VFD_28, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    Mort_mean    = mean(as.numeric(as.character(mortality_28d)),
                        na.rm = TRUE),
    Mort_se      = sd(as.numeric(as.character(mortality_28d)),
                      na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    N = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_outcomes <- outcomes_plot_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(VAPFD28_mean, VFD28_mean, Mort_mean),
                      names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    SE = case_when(
      Outcome == "VAPFD28_mean" ~ outcomes_plot_df$VAPFD28_se[
        match(Centre_SODD, outcomes_plot_df$Centre_SODD)],
      Outcome == "VFD28_mean"   ~ outcomes_plot_df$VFD28_se[
        match(Centre_SODD, outcomes_plot_df$Centre_SODD)],
      TRUE ~ outcomes_plot_df$Mort_se[
        match(Centre_SODD, outcomes_plot_df$Centre_SODD)]
    ),
    Outcome = recode(Outcome,
                     "VAPFD28_mean" = "VAPFD-28 (days)",
                     "VFD28_mean"   = "VFD-28 (days)",
                     "Mort_mean"    = "28-day Mortality (%)")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Centre_SODD, y = Value, fill = Centre_SODD)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Value - 1.96 * SE,
                    ymax = Value + 1.96 * SE),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Outcome, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SODD Centre"     = "#2980B9",
                               "Non-SODD Centre" = "#95A5A6")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Crude Outcomes by SODD Implementation Status",
    subtitle = "Mean ± 95% CI | Ecological comparison (unadjusted)",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Mean Value",
    fill     = NULL,
    caption  = "Note: Unadjusted comparison — confounding by center case-mix not accounted for"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "plain"), # face removed to respect guidelines
    strip.text      = element_text(face = "plain")
  )

print(p_outcomes)
ggsave("CLEAN_VAP_outputs/SODD/fig_outcomes_SODD_vs_nonSODD.pdf",
       p_outcomes, width = 10, height = 5)

# =============================================================================
# PART 2 — MIXED-EFFECTS MODEL (Center-level ATE)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  PART 2 — MIXED-EFFECTS MODEL (Center-level ATE)\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# Adjustment covariates (individual level)
covariates_adj <- intersect(
  c("AGE", "SEX", "SOFA", "APACHE_II", "CCI_score",
    "ICU_admission", "Duration_days_before_ICU",
    "Prescription_of_ATB", "Prescription_of_IS",
    "LT_corticosteroids", "Myocardial_infarction",
    "congestive_heart_failure", "COPD", "diabetes_mellitus",
    "CKD", "solid_tumor"),
  names(df_full)
)

# Treatment variable at the center level
df_full <- df_full %>%
  mutate(
    SODD_centre_bin = as.integer(Centre_SODD == "SODD Centre"),
    mortality_num   = as.numeric(as.character(mortality_28d))
  )

# Base formula
formula_fixed <- paste(
  "~", "SODD_centre_bin", "+",
  paste(covariates_adj, collapse = " + "),
  "+ (1 | site_abbreviation)"
)

outcomes_lme <- list(
  VAPFD_28    = "VAPFD_28",
  VFD_28      = "VFD_28",
  Mortality   = "mortality_num"
)

lme_results <- data.frame()

for (out_name in names(outcomes_lme)) {

  out_var <- outcomes_lme[[out_name]]

  cat(sprintf("─── Mixed-effects model : %s ─────────────────────\n", out_name))

  formula_lme <- as.formula(
    paste(out_var, formula_fixed)
  )

  fit_lme <- tryCatch({
    lmer(formula_lme, data = df_full, REML = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("lmer failed for ", out_name, " : ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })

  if (!is.null(fit_lme)) {

    # Extraction of the SODD_centre_bin coefficient
    coef_summary <- summary(fit_lme)$coefficients
    est  <- coef_summary["SODD_centre_bin", "Estimate"]
    se   <- coef_summary["SODD_centre_bin", "Std. Error"]
    tval <- coef_summary["SODD_centre_bin", "t value"]
    df_t <- coef_summary["SODD_centre_bin", "df"]
    pval <- coef_summary["SODD_centre_bin", "Pr(>|t|)"]

    ci_lo <- est - 1.96 * se
    ci_hi <- est + 1.96 * se

    cat(sprintf("  Estimate  : %.3f\n", est))
    cat(sprintf("  SE        : %.3f\n", se))
    cat(sprintf("  95%% CI    : [%.3f ; %.3f]\n", ci_lo, ci_hi))
    cat(sprintf("  p-value   : %s\n\n", format.pval(pval, digits = 3)))

    # ICC (proportion of inter-center variance)
    var_comps  <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit_lme))
    var_centre <- var_comps$vcov[var_comps$grp == "site_abbreviation"]
    var_resid  <- var_comps$vcov[var_comps$grp == "Residual"]
    icc        <- var_centre / (var_centre + var_resid)
    cat(sprintf("  ICC (inter-center variance) : %.3f\n\n", icc))

    lme_results <- rbind(lme_results, data.frame(
      Outcome  = out_name,
      Estimate = round(est,  3),
      SE       = round(se,   3),
      CI_Lo    = round(ci_lo, 3),
      CI_Hi    = round(ci_hi, 3),
      p_value  = format.pval(pval, digits = 3),
      ICC      = round(icc, 3),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

cat("\n─── MIXED-EFFECTS SUMMARY TABLE ─────────────────────────────\n")
print(lme_results, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(lme_results,
          "CLEAN_VAP_outputs/SODD/lme_results_SODD_ATE.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# Forest plot of mixed-effects results
p_lme <- ggplot(lme_results,
                aes(x = Estimate, y = Outcome)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "darkred", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_Lo, xmax = CI_Hi),
                 height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.9,
                 colour = "#2C3E50") +
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21,
             fill = "#2980B9", colour = "white") +
  labs(
    title    = "SODD Effect on Outcomes — Mixed-Effects Model",
    subtitle = "Adjusted for patient-level covariates | Random intercept by center",
    x        = "Estimated Effect (95% CI)",
    y        = NULL,
    caption  = "Center-level analysis | Ecological estimand"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "plain"))

print(p_lme)
ggsave("CLEAN_VAP_outputs/SODD/fig_lme_forest_SODD.pdf",
       p_lme, width = 7, height = 4)

# =============================================================================
# PART 3 — INDIVIDUAL ATE (Implementing centers + PS trimming)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  PART 3 — INDIVIDUAL ATE (AIPW / TMLE / GRF)\n")
cat("  Population: SODD centers only + PS trim [0.05;0.95]\n")
cat("=============================================================\n\n")

# ── Restrict to implementing centers ──────────────────────────────────────────
df_sodd_centres <- df_full %>%
  filter(Centre_SODD == "SODD Centre")

cat(sprintf("Initial N after restricting to SODD centers: %d patients\n",
            nrow(df_sodd_centres)))
cat(sprintf("N centers: %d\n\n",
            length(unique(df_sodd_centres$site_abbreviation))))

# ── MATRIX CORRECTION: Cleaning of the exposure variable ───────────
df_sodd_centres <- df_sodd_centres %>%
  mutate(SODD_num = as.numeric(as.character(SODD))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SODD_num))

cat("─── EXCLUSION OF MISSING DATA ───────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("N after removing NA for treatment: %d patients\n", nrow(df_sodd_centres)))
cat(sprintf("N treated  (SODD=1) : %d\n", sum(df_sodd_centres$SODD_num == 1)))
cat(sprintf("N controls (SODD=0): %d\n\n", sum(df_sodd_centres$SODD_num == 0)))

# ── Local PS estimation on this subpopulation ────────────────────────
# Integration of the cleaned variable into the equation
formula_ps <- as.formula(
  paste("SODD_num", "~", paste(covariates_adj, collapse = "+"))
)

ps_model_sodd <- tryCatch({
  weightit(formula_ps,
           data     = df_sodd_centres,
           method   = "ps",
           estimand = "ATE")
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("WeightIt failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
  NULL
})

if (is.null(ps_model_sodd)) {
  stop("Failed to estimate PS on SODD centers.")
}

df_sodd_centres$PS_local <- ps_model_sodd$ps

cat("─── PS DISTRIBUTION (SODD centers) ──────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("  Min  : %.3f\n", min(df_sodd_centres$PS_local)))
cat(sprintf("  Mean : %.3f\n", mean(df_sodd_centres$PS_local)))
cat(sprintf("  Max  : %.3f\n\n", max(df_sodd_centres$PS_local)))

# ── PS Trimming [0.05 ; 0.95] ────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_sodd_trim <- df_sodd_centres %>%
  filter(PS_local >= 0.05, PS_local <= 0.95)

cat(sprintf("N after PS trimming [0.05;0.95]: %d patients\n",
            nrow(df_sodd_trim)))
cat(sprintf("N treated  (SODD=1) : %d\n",
            sum(df_sodd_trim$SODD_num == 1)))
cat(sprintf("N controls (SODD=0) : %d\n\n",
            sum(df_sodd_trim$SODD_num == 0)))

if (nrow(df_sodd_trim) < 100) {
  warning("N < 100 after trimming — results should be interpreted with extreme caution.")
}

# ── Matrices for the estimators ────────────────────────────────────────────
dummy_sodd   <- dummyVars(~ ., data = df_sodd_trim[, covariates_adj])
X_sodd       <- as.matrix(predict(dummy_sodd,
                                  newdata = df_sodd_trim[, covariates_adj]))
X_sodd[is.na(X_sodd)] <- 0
X_sodd_df    <- as.data.frame(X_sodd)

PS_sodd      <- df_sodd_trim$PS_local

# Initialization of ATE results
ate_results <- data.frame(
  Approach = character(),
  Outcome  = character(),
  Estimate = numeric(),
  SE       = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

add_ate <- function(approach, outcome, est, se) {
  ate_results <<- rbind(
    ate_results,
    data.frame(Approach = approach, Outcome = outcome,
               Estimate = as.numeric(est), SE = as.numeric(se),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
  cat(sprintf("  ✓ %-30s | %-12s | %.3f (SE: %.3f)\n",
              approach, outcome, as.numeric(est), as.numeric(se)))
}

# ── Loop over the 3 outcomes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
for (out_name in names(outcomes_lme)) {

  out_var <- outcomes_lme[[out_name]]
  cat(sprintf("\n─── Outcome : %s ─────────────────────────────────\n", out_name))

  Y_s <- as.numeric(df_sodd_trim[[out_var]])
  
  # Integration of the cleaned treated variable
  W_s <- df_sodd_trim$SODD_num
  
  if (any(!W_s %in% c(0, 1)))
    W_s <- ifelse(W_s == max(W_s), 1, 0)

  # ── GRF ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tryCatch({
    set.seed(2026)
    cf_s   <- causal_forest(X_sodd, Y_s, W_s,
                            W.hat     = PS_sodd,
                            num.trees = 2000,
                            seed      = 2026)
    cf_ate <- average_treatment_effect(cf_s, target.sample = "all")
    add_ate("GRF (Causal Forest)", out_name,
            cf_ate["estimate"], cf_ate["std.err"])
  }, error = function(e) warning("GRF failed: ", conditionMessage(e)))

  # ── AIPW ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tryCatch({
    aipw_s <- AIPW$new(
      Y            = Y_s,
      A            = W_s,
      W            = X_sodd_df,
      Q.SL.library = "SL.glm",
      g.SL.library = "SL.glm",
      k_split      = 3,
      verbose      = FALSE
    )
    suppressWarnings(aipw_s$stratified_fit())
    aipw_s$summary()

    aipw_r <- tryCatch(
      aipw_s$result,
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(aipw_r) && "Mean Difference" %in% rownames(aipw_r)) {
      add_ate("AIPW (SL.glm)", out_name,
              aipw_r["Mean Difference", "Estimate"],
              aipw_r["Mean Difference", "SE"])
    }
  }, error = function(e) warning("AIPW failed: ", conditionMessage(e)))

  # ── TMLE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tryCatch({
    tmle_s <- tmle(
      Y            = Y_s,
      A            = W_s,
      W            = X_sodd_df,
      Q.SL.library = c("SL.glm", "SL.glmnet"),
      g.SL.library = c("SL.glm", "SL.glmnet")
    )
    add_ate("TMLE (SL.glm + glmnet)", out_name,
            tmle_s$estimates$ATE$psi,
            sqrt(tmle_s$estimates$ATE$var.psi))
  }, error = function(e) warning("TMLE failed: ", conditionMessage(e)))
}

# ── ATE summary table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n─── ATE SUMMARY TABLE (SODD — exploratory) ──────────────────\n")

ate_results <- ate_results %>%
  mutate(
    CI_Lo = Estimate - 1.96 * SE,
    CI_Hi = Estimate + 1.96 * SE,
    Significant = ifelse(CI_Lo > 0 | CI_Hi < 0,
                         "Significant", "NS")
  )

print(ate_results %>%
        mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))),
      row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(ate_results,
          "CLEAN_VAP_outputs/SODD/ate_results_SODD_implementing_centres.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# ── ATE Forest plot by outcome ───────────────────────────────────────────────
p_ate <- ggplot(
  ate_results,
  aes(x = Estimate, y = Approach, colour = Significant)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "darkred", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_Lo, xmax = CI_Hi),
                 height = 0.25, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21,
             aes(fill = Significant), colour = "white") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Significant" = "#E74C3C",
                                 "NS"          = "#7F8C8D")) +
  scale_fill_manual(  values = c("Significant" = "#E74C3C",
                                 "NS"          = "#7F8C8D")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Outcome, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    title    = "SODD — Average Treatment Effect (Exploratory)",
    subtitle = paste0("Restricted to SODD-implementing centers | ",
                      "PS-trimmed [0.05;0.95] | N=",
                      nrow(df_sodd_trim)),
    x        = "Estimated ATE (95% CI)",
    y        = NULL,
    colour   = NULL, fill = NULL,
    caption  = paste0(
      "Exploratory analysis — Supplementary Material\n",
      "Caution: limited sample size in implementing centers"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "plain"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text      = element_text(face = "plain")
  )

print(p_ate)
ggsave("CLEAN_VAP_outputs/SODD/fig_ate_forest_SODD_implementing.pdf",
       p_ate, width = 12, height = 5)

# =============================================================================
# END
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================\n")
cat("  SODD ANALYSIS COMPLETED\n")
cat("  Outputs : CLEAN_VAP_outputs/SODD/\n")
cat("  - table1_patient_SODD_vs_nonSODD.csv\n")
cat("  - table1_centre_level_SODD.csv\n")
cat("  - lme_results_SODD_ATE.csv\n")
cat("  - ate_results_SODD_implementing_centres.csv\n")
cat("  - fig_outcomes_SODD_vs_nonSODD.pdf\n")
cat("  - fig_lme_forest_SODD.pdf\n")
cat("  - fig_ate_forest_SODD_implementing.pdf\n")
cat("=============================================================\n")
```
